channel.title: Saswata S. Sengupta — Blog
channel.description: AI agents in production, e-commerce CRO, and AI-era product management — with the numbers.

item.title: DhanPlan: a retirement calculator that speaks Indian finance
item.description: Building a calculator where SIP/EPF/PPF/NPS and FIRE are first-class citizens — product choices from projections to inflation. Design, scope, and tests.

item.title: 20+ discovery calls to a top-3 roadmap brief
item.description: At Upcore I hunted 20+ prospects across 12 verticals; the output was a prioritized opportunity brief. The method behind turning interviews into a roadmap.

item.title: Simplest e-commerce CRO: ship one fix a week
item.description: A handful of heartfelt, repeatable wins — checkout trust, search weights, PDP details — each small, each measured. The cadence beats the splash.

item.title: What an AI-era product manager does all day
item.description: AI didn't remove the PM job — it moved the work up the judgment ladder. Specs get faster; decisions, scope, and risk reign. Real before/after inside.

item.title: The data deep-dive: 480K sessions to three real problems
item.description: The repeatable method I used across checkout, category pages, and forms: instrument first, form hypotheses second, never optimize an unmeasured funnel.

item.title: Topshe: voice AI that runs entirely in your browser
item.description: Wake word, speech-to-text, and a quantised Qwen 2.5 model in-browser via WebAssembly — no server, no API bill, no data left your device.

item.title: FilmRisk.AI: scoring film risk with ML and Bayesian priors
item.description: A 2,200-film dataset, gradient-boosted ML plus Bayesian priors, and a scoring engine that backtests itself. I built FilmRisk.AI — the failures included.

item.title: Daily report automation: 3 sources, 88 rows, 11 AM
item.description: A Google Apps Script pipeline unifying Kibana, MongoDB, and GA4 into one auto-populated report — and what white-collar automation really costs.

item.title: AI image greetings lifted feature engagement by 168%
item.description: A dormant 'Send Greetings' feature, an image-gen model, and a festival calendar across 27 occasions — feature engagement up 168%.

item.title: The 17:1 e-way bill gap: diagnosing B2B adoption
item.description: Why PRO+ users generated bills in Tally, not in-app — a two-week diagnostic that uncovered a 17:1 gap and changed the roadmap at C-suite level.

item.title: Gold/silver/bronze lead routing that cut days to close
item.description: Website forms at 63.5% CVR but chat at 4.7%? We built a lead scoring router that sends gold leads to humans and bronze to automation.

item.title: 27 push notification triggers, 5 regions, one architecture
item.description: Designing a notification system across renewals, transactional states, and conflict logic — with priority tiers and a daily cap users don't hate.

item.title: Category page redesign that added +34% qualified leads
item.description: A 4-week sprint on GA4 custom events and Clarity heatmaps turned story-led category journeys into +17% PDP clicks, +34% leads, −16% bounce.

item.title: How I built an AI recruiter agent for LinkedIn outreach
item.description: 766 commits, 6 releases, one self-hosted macOS app. The honest design and failure modes of an AI recruiter agent — research and intros, not spam.

item.title: How a form fix lifted lead submissions by 124% in 28 days
item.description: A field-by-field form teardown with GA4 events and Clarity — one field caused 23% of drop-offs. The fix raised lead submissions 124% in 28 days.

item.title: How we cut checkout abandonment from 73.1% to 53.9%
item.description: A 480K-session teardown: three separate checkout problems, three targeted fixes, two sprints — and a 26% relative drop in cart abandonment.
